summary.content:
Today's selection covers 83 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 51 on Artificial Intelligence and 12 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: AI music is flooding streaming services — but who wants it?
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Telegram Mini Apps abused for crypto scams, Android malware delivery
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from The Verge, BleepingComputer, BBC Technology, NY Times Tech, TechCrunch and others
• **Fresh Content**: 8 articles published in the last 24 hours
